༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dngos grub snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dngos grub snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swa sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ bla ma dang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gya gyus mngon par bsgrod mkhas gzung 'dzin mgron/ /dhu ti'i lam du nam yang bcom las slar/ /phung khams tshogs rnams 'od gsal 'bar ba'i spras/ /dga' ston mchog tu rol la ya mtshan dgyes/ /'di slad bcom pa'i rim pa las/ /ye shes 'khor lo bsreg blug gis/ /tshim byed rim pa 'dir spel te/ /las rnams thams cad mthar 'byin pa'o/ /de la 'dir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sgrub par 'dod pas/ cho ga sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ gnas dang mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar byas la/ dkyil 'khor bsdus nas/ sbyin sregs gang du bya ba'i sa gzhir dkyil chog ltar sa'i lha mo sta gon bya/ de nas sum bha brjod cing nang gtor lag pa rdo rje dang bcas pas dri bzang gis sa gzhi la byug cing*/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ nyer gcig yang dbus su rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa bzhag / oṃ bhu khaṃ sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ phur gdab byed na/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar sngo/ zhes pa nas/ byang chub ma thob gyi bar du bar chad bsrung bar gyur/ zhes mngon rtogs bzhin no/ /der tshangs thig dang*/ zur thig btab la/ lte ba nas g.yas g.yon du mtho gang gang gzhal ba'i sar zlum thig bskor ba'i/ khru gang zlum por 'gyur/ yang thab chung ngur byed na/ khru gang bskor ba'i/ bskum gru'i tshad du 'gyur ba dang*/ sor brgyad bskor te thabs kyi phyi'i tshad la gru gang du 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du phyi'i tshad las gzhan pa'i thig med pa spyi dang mthun pa'ang rung ngo*/ /de nas de'i phyir slar yang khru phye bskor te/ de la bskor thig rim pa gnyis kyis gsum gtubs su btang bas/

nang nas rim pa bzhin kha khyer dang*/ mu ran dang las kyi kha khyer dang gsum du 'gyur ro/ /thig phyi ma de nyid la reg par stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i thig btab ste/ 'di'i bya rjes zur thig gi steng nas lag len bzhin btsal bar bya'o/ /thabs kyis nang du padma 'dab brgyad kyi thig btab/ de nas tshon 'gyed cing mtshan ma 'god par bya ste/ thams cad kyang kha dog dkar po la ji ltar 'os pa'i bcad kyi ri mo bya'o/ /padma'i lte ba la rdo rje dang gri gug sngon po bris/ 'dab ma bzhi la kha ṭwāṃ ga re re bris te/ shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu padma/ byang du sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa dang*/ mtshams su bum thod bris/ ma grub na tshom bu bkod kyang rung*/ kha khyer la padma dkar po'i 'phreng ba/ mu ran la gri gug sngon po'i phreng ba/ las kyi kha khyer la rdo rje sngon po'i 'phreng ba stegs bu ser po grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rnams bri'o/ /bris thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'di las 'di ni bsdus pa'o/ /thab kyi zlum bskor dang mthun par 'o ma can gyi shing ngam/ nags kyi ba glang gi lci ba'i mtho gang tsam gyi dpangs zlum por brtsigs par bya'o/ /thab kyi shar lho me tshang dang*/ phye mar ting lo gcig bca'/ nang bud shing gis khengs par bya/ mthar mda' dra dang me long phur bu tshon skud rnams bca' ba'i lag len mdzad/ de rnams ma 'grub kyang mi 'gal/ dkyil 'khor la 'bul ba ltar phyogs mtshams brgyad du ku sha bkram/ sha chang gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma gsum dang*/ lced lde dang*/ bsangs chu'i dung chos ku sha'i 'thor g.yab dang bcas pa dang*/ rdor dril/ cang te'u/ nang mchod/ dung chos gnyis/ sgrub pa po 'jig rten pa'i shar du bltas pa'i thab kyi g.yas su mchod pa dang*/ g.yon du bsregs rdzas rnams mdun nas 'go brtsams te rim pas bsham/ yam shing 'o ma can gyi shing las byugs pa/ sbom su mthe'u chung tsam srid du sor brgyad nas gru gang gi bar gang yang rung ba/

sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis byug pa/ yal ga dang bcas pas kyang rung ste/ yam shing dang*/ rtsi bcud kyi mar khu yang legs par 'du bya la/ bum pa bca' zhing sgrub pa 'grub na nges par bya ba yin mod kyi/ bsdus pa la ma grub kyang 'gal ba med par shes par bya'o/ /de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas dang yo byad byin gyis rlabs pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bdag bskyed kyi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgom/ dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdus te/ bdag nyid phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas mchod yon gnyis/ sumbhas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ dang shaṃ las dung dkar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du hūṃ hūṃ las byung ba'i bsangs/ chu dang me lha dga' bar byed pa'i mchod yon nus pa thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ bsangs chu la dmigs nas sumbha gang mang dang*/ mchod yon la yi ge bdun pa nyer gcig tsam bzlas pa bya/ gnyis pa ni/ thab dang yod byad/ thams cad la bsangs chus gtor te/ sum bha/ sogs dang*/ oṃ swāhā 'i bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang ba/ zab su khru phyed pa kha khyer la padma dkar po'i 'phreng ba/ mu ran la gri gug gi 'phreng ba dang*/ las kyi kha khyer la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ las kyi kha khyer dang bcas pa/ phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa la zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gi gang bar gyur/ mchod rdzas dang*/ bsregs rdzas rnams mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi kā pa la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me togabadug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo dang bsregs rdzas rnams rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/

dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu/ las so so sgrub pa'i nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ/ nas/ a khaṃ swa hā'i bar brjod la rol chen bya/ oṃ a swāhā/ gsum gyis mar/ lan gsum gyis yam shing dang*/ oṃ shrī swāhās mar dang gsum gyis/ 'bru dang*/ oṃ dzi raṃ swāhās 'bru rnams dang*/ gsum gyis rdzas gzhan rnams dang*/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas rdzas gzhan rnams bsangs shing byin gyis rlabs par bya'o/ /de nas lced lde la me sbar te thal mo sbyar ba'i bzung*/ sum bha bzla zhing*/ thab la g.yon bskor gyis bskor ba lan gsum bya ste me tshangs du gzhug oṃ he ru ka mahā badzra dzwa la dzwa la hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes brjod bzhin pas/ mar khu blugs gzar chung ngur gsum blugs la me gsos so/ /de nas ku shas bsangs chu gtor la sumbha'i mthar/ oṃ swāhā btags pa'i bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las ye shes kyi me'i phung po rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po'i gdan la/ raṃ las dbyug gu rtse gsum pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa las me lha pā pa ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ mchod phyir thogs 'chang ba/ g.yas gnyis kyis dbyug gu dang mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ g.yon gnyis na bgrang phreng dang*/ spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun 'bab cing*/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ de'i thugs kar paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po grub pa'i mdun gyi zur la/ gzugs med khams dang sa bla dag pa hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ g.yas kyi zur du gzugs khams dang sa steng dag pa āḥlas padma āḥmatshan pa/

g.yon gyi zur du/ 'dod khams dang sa 'og dag pa oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ dbus su baṃ dang raṃ las dbyug gu rtse gsum pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ khams gsum gyi bdag po dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i me lha sku mdog dkar= nas/ 'phro ba/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin no/ / padma'i 'dab ma brgyad dang steng 'og tu/ oṃ end+ra ye/ agna ye/ ya mā ye/ nai ri ti ye/ wa ru ṇa ye/ wa ya we/ ku bai ra ye/ i shwa na ye/ udhaṃ bra hma/ a kṣo pri thi wi/ zhes brjod pas skad cig gis shar tu brgya byin dkar po glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhag 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa ne'u le 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa lcags sgrogs rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ g.yas gnyis bgrang phreng dang mchod spyin g.yon gnyis dbyug gu rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa dang ril bu spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po sngo nag ro langs la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha dud kha sha ba la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la zhon pa gaṇḍe 'dzin pa/ 'og tu sa lha ser po phag pa la zhon pa bum pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi rgyan dang cha lugs kyi mdzes pa'o/ /phyi nang gi lha de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ snying khar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po/ nas/ tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lhor nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa bkug par gyur/ dbyug gu rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/

oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog / bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ / oṃ e hya hi mahā bhu ta de wa ri ṣi/ dwi dza satta mahā gṛ st+waṃ a hu ri ma he ri aṣmi na sanni hi to bha wa/ oṃ he ru ka mahā badzra pā pa ka agna ye ma ma shintaṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ padma kā ma la ya st+waṃ/ zhes pas gdan phul/ oṃ he ru ka mahā badzra pā pa ka agna ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra titstsha swāhā/ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyi mchod/ oṃ agna ya swāhā/ lan bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la/ shrī he ru ka mahā badzra pā pa ka /oṃ agna ye/ a di bya/ a di bya/ ā bi sha ā bi sha shrī ye ha bya ka bya wa ha na ya swāhā/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad shanti ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul ba ni byon zan no/ / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ slar gnas gsum byin rlabs dang*/ go cha 'god pa sngar bzhin no/ / yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor phaiṃ/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha'i thugs ka nas/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad sprul te/ dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad he ru ka'i yig brgya'i mthar gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i snying po brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hūṃ/ yang sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsung shing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhis dbu rgyan/ oṃ pa dra laṃ pa abhi ṣiñtsa badzra tuṣt+ya/ oṃ ratna mā la abhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ sngar bzhin bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa/

srung ba dang gtsang byed dam pa nus pa phul du phyin par gyur/ oṃ badzra sa twa a/ lan brgyad brjod la ku sha bkrams par bsam la/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /sa la skyes pa'i snying po mchog / ces pa'i ku sha phul/ 'dis bdag cag 'khor bcas la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig swāhā/ sum bha lan brgyad brjod cing*/ mda'i dra bas mdzes shing*/ me long gi phreng ba la sogs pas yongs su bskor bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ mda' dra sogs bcings par bsam/ me lha'i zhal dang dgang blugs kyi rtse mor/ oṃ oṃ oṃ ḍā ki ni dzi na dzi ka swāhā/ zhes lan gcig brjod/ gong gi byon zan 'bul ba'i skabs ltar/ oṃ agna/ dgang gzar lan gsum gyis bkang la/ auṃ he ru ka mahā badzra pā pa ka agna ye st+waṃ/ zhes lan gsum phul/ skabs 'dir me bkra brtag ngan na bgegs skrad/ mchod yon gyis snod bzung ste/ oṃ he ru ka mahā badzra pā pa ka agna ye pra bar sarka ra pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes mchod yon dang po dang*/ oṃ i maṃ arghaṃ ma ya dad taṃ/ gṛhṇa sid dhi mme pra yatstsha ye swāhā/ gnyis pa dang*/ oṃ i maṃ padyaṃ mas ya dad taṃ/ gṛhṇa sid dhi mme pra yatstsha ye swāhā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ he ru ka mahā badzra pā pa ka agha ye sa pa ri wa ra puṣpe/ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ na nga mchod 'bul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ tshangs dbang 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su skyob pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gi sku sprul pa/ /rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rigs sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi bcud ldan gandhe bsnams/

/nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /shes rab chen po bdag med thugs chud cing*/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba kun sgrol yang*/ / thabs la mkhas pas drang srong cha lugs 'dzin/ /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad rab stsol ba/ /rang gzhan don sbyor sa la bzhugs/ /tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i bstod/ bsreg rdzas thams cad la bsangs chu gtor te/ oṃ swāhā/ lan mang du brjod/ de nas yam shing 'bul zhing*/ oṃ he ru ka mahā badzra pā pa ka agna ye/ zhes pa ni lha sngags/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ye swāhā/ yam shing gi rdzas sngags/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sarba pa paṃ shintaṃ ku ru swāhā/ las sngags te/ dal ba'i tshe gsum char sgrags pa nyer gcig la sogs pa'i phul/ bsdu na lha sngags dang*/ las sngags lan gcig gis bar du/ rdzas sngags kyi mthar

swāhā sbyar ba/ bdun nam nyer gcig phul/ rdzas sngags so so'i khyad par ma btogs 'og ma rnams la 'di'i rigs 'gre bar byas te/ so so'i rdzas sngags ni/ oṃ agna ye swāhās mar khu'o/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swāhā sa til/ oṃ he ru ka mahā badzra agna ye swāhās 'bras chan/ oṃ sarba sa po te swāhās zas mchog oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swāhā sa dur ba/ oṃ mi hā be ga ye swāhā sa nas/ oṃ badzra gnasmi ri ye swāhā sa gro/ oṃ badzra bi dza ye swāhā/ so ba la sogs pa'i 'bru sna tshogs/ oṃ badzra puṣpe ye swāhā sa 'bras/ oṃ mahā ba la ye swāhā sa sran ma/ oṃ mahā shri pha la dha ni swāhā sa 'dza' ti la sogs pa'i 'bras bu rnams/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ye swāhā sa ku sha rnams 'bul mar khu blugs gzar dang*/ gzhan rnams lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis kha gyen du bstan pas 'bul/ nyer gcig sogs mang nyung long skabs dang sbyar/ de nas gong bzhin phyi mchod nang mchod/ shes rab chen po bdag med thugs chud cing*/ sogs dang*/ gzi brjid chen po me ye lha/ zhes pa yan chad kyis bstod/ oṃ he ru ka dzwa la dzwa la hūṃ hūṃ zhes brjod/ mar khu dgang blugs rkyang ba gang phul nas/ me lha thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ mchod rdzas/ bsregs rdzas rnams kha gsos la me dang bcas pa thams cad gong bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ mchod pa dang bsregs rdzas byin gyis rlabs pa'i sngags rnams gong bzhin brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las me nang du srung ba'i 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badzra bha wa bhanda hūṃ/ oṃ badzra pra ka ra hūṃ laṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badzra pañtsa ra hūṃ paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badzra bi ta na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badzra sa ra dzwa la dri saṃ draṃ/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na arka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes sngags drug po lan gsum brjod/

srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las= zhes pa nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus su gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po= nas/ rdo rje'i phreng ba'i mtshan pa'o'i bar mngal dkyil bzhin bskyed/ dur khrod chen por shar du tshangs pa/ byang du gzhon nu karti ka nub tu khyab 'jug lhor dbang phyug chen po 'khor dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying ga= zhes pa nas/ de nas phaiṃ zhes pa'i bar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bzhin/ oṃ badzra he ru ka e hya hi/ bha ga wan i ha wa kya sa ma ye na tsa pañtsa a mṛ ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha st+waṃ pu dza pra wa ra ya mi/ da kyil 'khor rgyal mchog ltar phyi mchod 'bul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ bha ra maṇḍa la la tsakra sarba bi ra yo gi ni/ oṃ agne ye swāhā/ lan bdun gyis bkang la/ a di bya/ sogs kyis sngags sbyar nas gong ltar byon zan 'bul/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharma yo ga shuddho ྅ haṃ/ gtso bo yab yum kyi gnas rnams su snying gar oṃ oṃ ha nas brlar ha ljang khu nas don yod grub pa'i ngo bo'i bar/ 'khor rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ slar yang*/ nas/ dbang lha spyan 'dren= nas/ dam tshig 'khor lo pa rnams la don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan/ zhes pas bar dbang bskur yang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bzhin byas la/ dar dpyangs dang*/ rin po che'i phreng ba'i sngags gong bzhin/ auṃ pa tra laṃ pa a bhi ṣiñtsa badzra tuṣt+ya/ oṃ ratna ma la a bhi ṣiñtsa draṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas lha thams cad sems dpa' sum brtsegs su gyur/ gtso bo'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i thig le'i nang du dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyi nang gi lha thams cad 'od zer dkar po 'bar ba zhi ba'i thugs can du gyur/ de nas spro na mdun bskyed bzhin nam/

bsdu na dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bzhin mchod bstod rdzogs par bya/ de nas sreg rdzas 'bul tshul/ lha sngags rgyas pa ni lha rang rang gi rtsa sngags brjod pa dang*/ 'bring la gtso bo yab yum la rang sngags gzhan rnams la sa bon/ bsdus pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ bha ra maṇḍal tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi ni/ sogs sbyor tshul mang du gsungs kyang phyag len la dang po yam shing la/ rang sngags rdzogs pa'i lha sngags kyis rjes su/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ye swāhā/ nyer gcig gis phul nas/ las sngags ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sarba pā paṃ shintaṃ ku ru swāhā/ sarba bighan/ sarba ro ṣa/ sarba duṣṭha na/ sarba byā he/ sarba dzwa ra/ sarba gra he/ sarba dur mi ti/ sarba dur sopni/ sarba a ka la mṛ dyur shintaṃ kuru/ de nas gong bzhin sreg rdzas tshar re la lha sngags gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po'am/ nye snying gang rung gi mthar/ rdzas sngags kyi grangs nyer gcig sogs ji tsam 'os pa'i 'bul la/ mjug tu las sngags gong bzhin lan re re brjod/ de nas slar yang grangs kyi ngo bo til sngags 'ba' zhig la grangs 'dzin pa yin no/ /yang na grangs 'dzin pa'i skabs 'dir/ oṃ shrī he ru ka bi ma he bi dya rā dza dhi ma ye bi ra pra tso tha ya āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa dbyangs skyong gi sngags kyis phul yang rung ngo*/ /bsreg rdzas 'bul ba rdzogs pa dang*/ sgrub thabs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ltar mchod bstod byas la/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar yi dam/ chos skyong mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs gtor ma 'bul bar bya'o/ /de nas bkra shis rgyas bsdus gang rung byas la/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan bdun tsam bzlas nas/ lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ yig brgya'i mthar/ oṃ he ru ka mu / zhes pas ye shes pa gshegs/ sbyin sreg gi thal ba cung zad blangs/ rang gi gnas gsum du byugs la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ

dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim/ zhes brjod/ de dag ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /gsum pa mjug ni/ slar yang mar blug gzar gang phul ba'i rkyen gyis/ me lha thugs dkyil dang bcas pa sngar bzhin grub par gyur/ gong 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i skabs ltar/ sreg rdzas rnams tshar gcig rdzogs par phul la/ gong ltar mchod bstod bya/ slar yang sngags bdun gyis dgang blugs gang phul/ me lha'i gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ oṃ he ru ka mahā badzra pā pa ka agna ye sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhya sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs pa mgon gyis sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭakkis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /me lha drang srong 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyi 'dod don gsol 'debs/ oṃ ind+ra ye nas/ pṛ thi wi de wi bhyaḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs kyis phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma phul/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gi nang mchod/ he ru ka dpal ye shes ni/ /gang la gang 'dul thabs sprul pa/ /phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor bcas rnams/ / thogs med las kun mdzad la bstod/ /phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma= sogs kyi 'phrin las gzhol/ slar yang gshegs skyems kyi tshul du/ oṃ agna ye swāhā/ lan bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la/ oṃ he ru ka sogs gong gi sngags dang bcas pa'i mar dgang blugs lan gsum phul la yig brgya lan gsum bzlas/ ma 'byor ba sogs/ spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du phyir bskyed la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis mdzad lags kyi/ /mgu zhing tshim par gyur nas kyang*/

/rang gnas bde bar gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ agna ye ya hi badzra muḥ sngar phur gdab dngos su phur bu bcu dang lnga la brten nas byas pa yin na/ rang rang gi phur pa 'byin sngags dang phyag rgyas dbyung*/ yid kyis btab pa tsam la ni phur ba dbyung bar bsams pa tsam las sngags dang phyag rgya mi dgos so/ /de nas bdag nyid go cha gsum gyis bsrungs nas/ smon lam dang bkra shis sogs bya'o/ /me ma shi bar mi dkrug cing*/ rang shi la song ba na bum par blug la chu bor spyan 'dren pa/ rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren pa dang 'dra'o/ /de dag gi lag len dang mthar gcod pa ni gzhan dang gzhan la blta bar bya'o/ /de rnams kyi sdom ni/ sa chog thab khung bca' ba dang*/ /yo byad bsags shing bum pa sgrub/ /gtor ma gnas yo byin rlabs dang*/ /bdag bskyed chu gnyis sgrub pa dang*/ /rdzas byin rlabs shing me sbar zhing*/ /thab khung me lha phyi nang bskyed/ /byin rlabs spyan 'dren gdan phul mchod/ /byon zan phul stim go cha dgod/ /dbang bskur ku sha mda' drang bcings/ /me bkra brtag cing mchod bstod bya/ /bsreg rdzas mchod bstod dgang blugs phul/ /bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs srung 'khor dang*/ /gzhal med khang dang lha tshogs bskyed/ /spyan 'dren mchod bstod byon zan 'bul/ /go cha bcings nas dbang bskur bya/ /sems dpa' sum brtsegs zhi ba'i gzugs/ /mchod bstod bsregs rdzas mchod bstod 'bul/ /shis brjod yig brgya bzod par gsol/ /gshegs gsol dam tshig nye bar bsdu/ /dgang blugs bsregs rdzas mchod bstod dang*/ /dgang blugs me lha phyogs skyong gi /gtor 'bul gshegs skyems kha skong dang*/ /bzod gsol gshegs gsol phur bu dbyung*/ /nyer bsdu smon lam bkra shis bya/ /thal ba chu bor spyan 'dren te/ /sbyin sregs las kyi spyi sdom yin/ /de ltar mchog dang thun mong dngos grub don/ /mtha' dag 'phrin las nye bar sgrub pa'i gzhi/

/bsregs blugs cho ga ma nor skyon bral ba/ /mdo tsam go bde'i ngag gis 'dir gsal byas/ /'di bris dge ba'i 'gro ba kun/ /sngags rgyud sbyor ba mthar phyin te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa grub nas/ /don gnyis phun sum tshogs par shog/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdor bsdus pa dngos grub snye ma zhes bya ba/ don gnyer mang po'i bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer brgyad pa la chos 'khor sdings su nye bar sbyar ba'o/ /zhus dag/maṅga laṃ// //dge'o dge'o dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dngos grub snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 782--PAGE 339--PAGE 338-
